spec.description: Up/down status, request rate/latency, and worker queue health for every service added by the observability migration - the dashboard the infra-health alert rules (services/grafana/provisioning/alerting/rules.yml) are conceptually about.

spec.title: MCP dev
spec.description:
Goal: quickly see if the mcp-dev MCP service is up.
Description: combines the Prometheus `up` scrape result for job mcp-dev with the blackbox exporter's HTTP health-check probe for that instance into a single UP/DOWN stat.

spec.title: MCP stats
spec.description:
Goal: quickly see if the mcp-stats MCP service is up.
Description: combines the Prometheus `up` scrape result for job mcp-stats with the blackbox exporter's HTTP health-check probe for that instance into a single UP/DOWN stat, mirroring the "mcp-stats is down" alert rule's own query.

spec.title: Scrape targets
spec.description: up{} across every Prometheus scrape job - one row per exporter/service the observability stack itself depends on to see anything at all.

spec.title: Firing alerts
spec.description: Grafana-managed alert rules (services/grafana/provisioning/alerting/rules.yml) currently firing, pending, or erroring.

spec.title: Blackbox exporter
spec.description: All blackbox probe-scrape series share one exporter process - if any go to 0 together, the exporter itself is unreachable, not just one probed target.

spec.title: Prometheus
spec.description: Self-scrape - if this goes stale/DOWN, every other panel on this dashboard is suspect too.

spec.title: Memory fragmentation ratio
spec.description: RSS/used-memory ratio - sustained values well above 1 mean the OS is holding memory Redis isn't using (fragmentation); below 1 can mean swapping.

spec.title: Request rate
spec.description:
Goal: track HTTP request throughput for the mcp-dev service.
Description: sums the rate of http_requests_total over 5m windows for the mcp-dev instance, grouped by handler.

spec.title: Latency (p50/p90/p95)
spec.description:
Goal: track HTTP request latency percentiles for the mcp-dev service.
Description: histogram_quantile over http_request_duration_seconds_bucket for the mcp-dev instance at the 0.50/0.90/0.95 quantiles, grouped by handler.

spec.title: Request rate
spec.description:
Goal: track HTTP request throughput for the mcp-stats service.
Description: sums the rate of http_requests_total over 5m windows for the mcp-stats instance, grouped by handler.

spec.title: Latency (p50/p90/p95)
spec.description:
Goal: track HTTP request latency percentiles for the mcp-stats service.
Description: histogram_quantile over http_request_duration_seconds_bucket for the mcp-stats instance at the 0.50/0.90/0.95 quantiles, grouped by handler.
